```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)

```

```{r}
#| cache: true

urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_imdb <- function(url, snap_year) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      response <- request(url) |>
        req_timeout(30) |>
        req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
        req_perform()

      table_node <- resp_body_html(response) |>
        html_element("table")
      imdb_table <- html_table(table_node, convert = FALSE)

      parsed_title <- str_match(
        str_squish(imdb_table[["Rank & Title"]]),
        "^(\\d+)\\.\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\((\\d{4})\\)$"
      )
      title_attr <- table_node |>
        html_elements("td.ratingColumn.imdbRating strong, td.imdbRating strong") |>
        html_attr("title")
      number <- title_attr |>
        str_extract("(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
        str_remove_all(",") |>
        as.integer()

      result <- tibble(
        snap_year = as.integer(snap_year),
        rank = as.integer(parsed_title[, 2]),
        title = parsed_title[, 3],
        year = as.integer(parsed_title[, 4]),
        rating = readr::parse_number(imdb_table[["IMDb Rating"]]),
        number = number
      )

      if (nrow(result) != 250L) {
        stop("Expected 250 rows from the IMDb chart; received ", nrow(result), ".")
      }

      result
    },
    error = \(error) {
      message("Could not scrape the ", snap_year, " IMDb snapshot: ", conditionMessage(error))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(urls, years, scrape_imdb) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10,
    rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)
  ) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, name = "n_snapshots") |>
  count(n_snapshots)
```

```{r}
rank_change_by_decade <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2015 - rank_2022,
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10
  ) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell"),
    release_decade = factor(release_decade, levels = sort(unique(release_decade)))
  )

ggplot(rank_change_by_decade, aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Rose" = "#2C7FB8", "Fell" = "#D95F0E")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate films rose in the rankings from 2015 to 2022",
    x = "Average signed rank change (2015 rank - 2022 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "190 films appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots"
  )
```
